news.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is almost here, and in case players weren't already excited to return to classic Az

content.v: World of Warcraft: Forever is almost here, and in case players weren't already excited to return to classic Azeroth, a new animated music video highlighting the war between the Horde and the Alliance is sure to get your inner player vs. player hyped up to spill some blood for your faction.

Called "Warpath," the animated trailer made in collaboration between developer Blizzard and Brunch Studio features a banger of a track performed by YouTuber turned musician Poppy, Amy Lee of Evanescence fame, and Courtney LaPlante, the lead singer of Canadian metal band Spiritbox. The name of the song itself is "End of You," and its nu-metal vibes go a long way to invoke the early 2000s era that WoW originally spawned from.

The trailer shows members of the Horde (an orc Rogue, tauren Hunter, undead Paladin, troll Mage) and the Alliance (a human Warrior, gnome Warlock, dwarf Shaman, night elf Priest, and Skyborne Druid) duking it out on the slopes of Mount Hyjal, one of Forever's new zones.

Each class is wearing their iconic endgame dungeon armor set and can be seen wielding more than a few recognizable weapons, like Unstoppable Force, Dal'Rend's Sacred Charge and Tribal Guardian, and others.

It's not the first time Blizzard has collaborated with Brunch on an AMV. Blizzard released "A Place To Call Home" performed by Aurora earlier this year ahead of the release of modern WoW's Midnight expansion, and it was quite the walk down memory lane for longtime players.

Forever's launch may be right around the corner, but Blizzard isn't slowing down when it comes to announcements and changes. Most recently, it announced one last round of racial ability changes prior to launch day and the last-minute addition of another PvP server option. It will also make major improvements to the game's controversial layering system.

In an interview with GameSpot, Blizzard detailed how it's approaching Forever's endgame and what the future will hold for what will be the third major version of its enduring MMORPG. WoW: Forever launches November 4, with character creation and name reservations going live October 27 for those who purchased the game's new optional playable race, Skyborne elves.

news.title: 《魔兽世界》永久名称预订在发布前被打破
news.summary: The World of Warcraft Forever beta ended last week, and in the space in between that and the full launch on No

others.title: 《魔兽世界：永远》在发布前刚刚进行了另一次重大种族能力调整

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/19/wow-forever-scenic-announce-skyborne-customization-062-1789806035954.png

The World of Warcraft Forever beta ended last week, and in the space in between that and its full launch on November 4, Blizzard is offering players the ability to reserve character names ahead of release. There's only one problem: the system looks like it's broken.

Right now, the name reservation system is only supposed to be available in Europe, with North American servers getting a name reservation window starting at 1pm PT/4pm ET today. But the WoW Forever team has issued a message to players in the Battle.net client, saying "World of Warcraft: Forever Name Reservations are delayed while we resolve some final technical issues. Thank you for your patience!"

The way the name reservation system is supposed to work is that, by launching the latest version of WoW Forever, players will be able to pick a ruleset (PvE, PvP, etc,) and then create up to three characters with reserved names. But, for a lot of European players, the blue 'Play' button on the Battle.net launcher is grayed out, meaning they can't even get into the game to try and make a new character.

Just like with any sort of World of Warcraft delay, players have taken to the WoW forums to voice their discontent, in a massive 120-post thread. Player Equinox posted, "There is literally nothing going right the first time something new launches. It's ridiculous how they manage it every time to screw things up." Meanwhile, Katerlina asked , "They did this already for USA right? Or are we the test?" And, no, Blizzard has not launched the feature in the U.S. quite yet.

Some players have found a workaround that gets them in the game, but it doesn't seem to be doing a lot of good right now. Aureliani posted "Go to install folder of forever and just start wow.exe, use email + password, and that at least brings me to the rulesets (that are still greyed out though)."

While it probably won't get you into the game any faster, player Bìsh has some helpful advice , saying, "If the PLAY button its greyed out, that means your launcher was set in another region. I dunno why, but mine was set to Americas. I logged out from Battlenet, I clicked switch accounts to clear the name of the account also, and in the right corner there is a cog where you can put it back to Europe. After I've done that, the PLAY button its not greyed out anymore."

There are only a couple more hours before this feature launches in the U.S., and unless Blizzard figures out the root cause of this issue ahead of time, it's likely that NA players are going to experience delays, too. Either way, hopefully these kinds of issues aren't present when WoW Forever gets its full launch on November 4.

Ahead of WoW Forever's launch, we got a chance to sit down with Blizzard principal game designer Kris Zierhut to talk about the future of the MMO . It sounds like updates will be coming regularly, and we might get a chance to visit some of the continents that got added in expansions, like Northrend and Pandaria .

news.title: 继《鬼武者》专注的剑术之后，《幻刃零》呈现出一部庞大、极简主义的动作史诗
news.summary: A truly enormous wuxia journey.

content.v: At just about 15 hours into Phantom Blade Zero, I've changed out my primary weapons more times than I do in an entire Souls campaign. I quickly dropped my starter sword for a pair of dual blades and a jagged weapon that chunks damage off my enemies in showers of blood. But I didn't stick with either for long. Soon I was running around with a two-handed blade taller than my martial arts hero Soul, which sprouts a trail of magical, energy-sapping flowers with every swing. It shares a moveset with another two-handed giant that absorbs life with each hit. But I don't have time to use either one: I'm already smitten with my new twin blades, one of which I can send spinning in a circle around me like a protective Beyblade.

Somehow I haven't even touched the weapon that I took off a crazed monk that turns Soul into a drunken boxer. But I'm sure I'll have time: apparently I'm less than a third(!) of the way through a game that's far, far bigger than I anticipated when I played a chunk of it last year .

For the most part, Phantom Blade Zero's epic ambition is exciting—PC Gamer senior guides writer Sean Martin promises me that I've got about a hundred thrilling boss fights left to come. Its first dozen hours also illustrate the dangers of a long-in-development game ballooning in scope.
House of flying phrases

While playing Phantom Blade Zero I've been thinking a lot about this season's other big action game, which also spent more than half a decade in development: Capcom's revival of Onimusha . That game wastes little time in introducing its protagonist Miyamoto Musashi or the forces he'll be up again. He's brash and headstrong, taunting a group of samurai after whipping up on their master—then leading them on a Looney Tunes-style chase when there are too many to fight at once. The game punctures this silly tone shortly after introducing Musashi's rival, Ganryu, when both are murdered by demonic Genma.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Bwy9yQRb2ACRgvEivCQfvn-1920-80.jpg

Musashi's saved when he's given an oni gauntlet in the afterlife and sent back to the land of the living to harness souls with it; the rest of the game is about him deciding who and what he fights for. It's about that personal journey first and foremost, with the machinations of the game's villain spurring him along—and fantastic acting and facial motion capture do a ton of the work to make the story compelling.

In Phantom Blade Zero, by contrast, I've already lost track of the tangled web of characters, relationships, betrayals and motivations with dozens of hours to go. I've seen (and played) flashbacks to Soul's childhood, teenage years, and recent past; I've watched cutscenes about his enemy doing some Machiavellian scheming with another guy I can't name; I've read dozens of cryptic messages scattered throughout each zone that are meant to explain more about why I'm fighting puppets, dudes whose bodies have "transcended" into pure energy, monks who coat their bodies in hardened gold, and mean dogs. (Actually, nothing has explained the dogs yet).

I appreciate PBZ's attempt to start in media res and give Soul a sense of urgency—we flash back to him being stabbed through the heart, then shortly after flash forward to him getting a temporary fake heart that will fail on him in 66 days. But the flashbacks and bits of incidental storytelling often feel like infodumps from someone who's spent years writing a massive story bible and has lived with the whole thing in their head for so long that they don't realize how hard it is to follow when you're coming in with zero context.

Take these flowers, Phantom Blade Zero's way of doling out health upgrades. You'll find them scattered around each area, and finding all of them (usually around 3-6) will net you about 10% more health. Each plays 30 seconds or so of dialogue, and the writing's often vague references to characters and events I've never witnessed mostly makes me want to mash the skip button. We're far from the evocative audio vignettes of BioShock, here.

Onimusha: Way of the Sword has some plenty forgettable sidequests, too, but it also features a number of quests that reinterpret Japanese fables written by Lady Murasaki , the author of The Tale of Genji. These sidequests are great , embellished with unique art that inspired me to read more Japanese mythology. Like Onimusha's main story, they're simple and straightforward, but with just enough flair to make them compelling.

So far Phantom Blade Zero is a lot more convoluted than my favorite wuxia films, with small casts of characters and straightforward motivations—a love story, a "save the small town from a corrupt official" story , a ghost story . But when its epic sweep means I get to play with an absolutely luxurious variety of weapons, I'm not exactly heartbroken that the story is less than riveting.
Ways of the sword
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PYSRM3EGBSDnV5Cnfw5aaF-1920-80.jpg
In Onimusha: Way of the Sword, I started the game with sword, and I ended the game with sword. At no point in between did I wield anything but sword.

This is not a complaint. I'm not sure another videogame has done sword better than Onimusha frankly ever —the physicality of it, the dance between blocks, deflects and parries, the lightning strike of an issen—the animations and weighty physics in Onimusha combine to create a game rich in sensory feedback even with none of the complex combos of, say, Devil May Cry.

The old Capcom playbook in that vein of character action game is to give you a handful of weapons, each with a lengthy list of button inputs that create slightly different attacks; stringing them together is visually satisfying and keeps your combo counter ticking up and up. Modern Soulslikes offer way more weapons, but at the expense of that rich variety—each weapon type has a couple unique animations to its name, and that's it.

Phantom Blade Zero blends those two approaches, with the weapon variety of a modern action RPG but the feel and combo mad flourishes of 2000s character action games. Each of Soul's weapons has a fairly limited basic combo string, but also wholly unique mechanic that impacts how you use it in a fight. And each weapon has an upgrade path that adds one or two new actions to its repertoire.

The Outlaw Warblade, one of those massive two-handed swords I mentioned at the start, initially drains enemy health with basic attacks, and lets you convert your own health into recoverable damage to perform enhanced guard-breaking attacks. After five upgrades, it gains a new attack that lets you tank damage while you charge it up and instantly restores a chunk of HP if you land the hit. After 15 upgrades, it grants you an "emergency shield" for continuously sapping your own health, rewarding living on the edge.

Like Onimusha, Phantom Blade Zero's boss fights are definitely its highlights, with the arena designs and one-off mocapped stunts making it clear why this game took so long to make. The big difference between the two, though, is how much world PBZ has in and around those fights. So far I've found progression a bit more linear than I hoped, with levels that are Dark Souls- esque but with fewer surprising paths linking back to previous areas. Still, they're peppered with diversions that are closed off until you acquire certain weapons, and lots of overlooks and out-of-reach treasures that taunt you to double-check for routes you might have missed.

news.title: GTA 6 文件大小揭晓，而且非常大
news.summary: Ahead of the game's release in November, GTA 6' s file size has been revealed, and it is massive. PlayStation

content.v: Ahead of the game's release in November, GTA 6' s file size has been revealed, and it is massive. PlayStation Game Size reports that the $80 standard edition will take up 210GB of storage capacity.

Size details for the $100 Ultimate Edition--which includes a ton of content not in the regular version--were not made available. We also don't know the Xbox Series X|S file size, but it's likely around the same.

As announced previously, preloading for GTA 6 begins on November 12, which is good news considering the game is massive in terms of its file size. People will no doubt have to delete other content to fit the game on the PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. This is double the file size of Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption II.

Everyone expected GTA 6's file size to be gigantic, but now there is a number behind it, and it's one that makes it among the largest games ever in terms of file size. GTA 6's map is three times bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2's , and the game is filled with lots of detail in the vein of that game's horse testicles .

GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it's expected to be the biggest game of all time. One report said the game could hit 25 million preorders by launch, generating $2 billion in revenue .
GTA 6 is a strictly single-player game, but it's safe to assume that Rockstar will eventually release a new version of GTA Online . A PC edition, meanwhile, is expected in early 2027 .

news.title: 战锤 40,000：Boltgun 工作室宣布大规模裁员，然后迅速删除该公告
news.summary: Auroch Digital just released Boltun 2 two weeks ago, and it's got Warhammer Survivors lined up for launch in N

content.v: GamesIndustry Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun developer Auroch Digital appears to be headed toward significant layoffs. In a statement posted to LinkedIn, since deleted but reported by GamesIndustry and others, the studio said that despite its "creative success, the same market conditions that have challenged so many of our fellow developers have now also affected us." As a result, Auroch Digital is restructuring, and has begun a redundancy consultation process that will impact "around a quarter" of its employees.

"Over the past year our colleagues have delivered amazing games like Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 and Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War! to wonderful reception from our players," the Auroch Digital statement said.

"Despite that creative success, the same market conditions that have challenged so many of our fellow developers have now also affected us. Consequently, we have made the decision to restructure the studio to work through a turbulent and uncertain time in our industry."

As noted, that message has since been deleted, and there's no trace of it elsewhere, aside from gaming sites that have previously reported on it. However, at least two Auroch Digital employees have also reported the redundancy notification.

Assuming there's not been some massive miscommunication here, the cuts come despite a good run for Auroch Digital over the past few years. Released in 2023, Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun was "the first truly exceptional Warhammer 40,000 game since Dawn of War ," we declared in our 85% review ; the follow-up, Boltgun 2 , is "sick," in the words of PC Gamer shooter expert Morgan Park, and currently holds an "overwhelmingly positive" rating on Steam.

Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War didn't meet quite the same enthusiastic response—I enjoyed the preview build I played but our reviewer Nova Wright did not care for the full release—but the studio also has Warhammer Survivors in the pipe, set to launch on November 10, and it looks very promising.
The seeming bad news also comes less than a year after Auroch Digital was acquired by Roundtable Interactive in a deal backed by EMK Capital.

Anyway, it's all a bit strange. Why Auroch Digital would announce the pending layoff of a quarter of its staff—which clearly happened—and then erase all trace of that message shortly after is anyone's guess, but I strongly suspect there's no good answer. I've reached out to the studio for comment and will update if I receive a reply.

news.title: 关于洛可王国，您需要了解的关于风靡全球的生物收集热潮的知识
news.titleEn: What You Need to Know About Roco Kingdom, the Creature-Collecting Sensation Going Global

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/27/header-key-art-1793120731574.jpg
在腾讯摩风工作室开发的全新免费游戏《洛克王国》中，您将扮演来自魔法学院的法师洛克，踏上明亮多彩的卡罗西亚世界，踏上收集吉尼斯的冒险之旅。这些吉尼是卡罗西亚本地的神奇生物，这片土地上有大量不同的吉尼。目前Morefun的内测正在进行中，玩家已经可以体验卡罗西亚的魔法世界和洛克王国所提供的一切。

《Roco Kingdom》中有多种不同种类的 Jinies 可供收集，事实上，在测试中将有 212 种独特的 Jinies 可供收集，不过随着游戏的全面推出，您预计还会有数百种 Jinies 出现。瓦格海姆（Vargheim）是一只像狼一样的基尼（Jini），拥有坚韧的爪子和充当天然盔甲的毛皮； Cluckchamp，一只武士鸡；布拉法 (Bluffa)，一只可爱而活泼的战斗熊；还有 Duckiji，一只超级柔软的鸭子，它喜欢在卡罗西亚周围发现闪亮的物体。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/27/different-character-have-different-expression-1793121230401.jpg

Though some Jinies look similar, every single Jini you encounter in Roco Kingdom is unique. That’s because each Jini varies in talents, personality types, height, weight, color, and specialities. Two Bluffas could be entirely different, with one having a stubborn personality (which means they have higher physical attack abilities), the other Bluffa could possess a cheerful personality, marked by their distinct smile. Jinies also have their own innate and unique specialities, like Shared Ride, which allows a Jini to carry you on its back as you explore, or Sharer, which can trigger bonus drops when using that Jini. There are, of course, visual differences, too. Some Jinies have a Chromatic variant, which gives a Jini a completely different color scheme. If you are lucky enough to find a Prism Pod, you can use them to capture Jinies and create a new random color gradient, which combine with glittery effects to make your Jini one of a kind. Some Jinies even have distinct physical variants that go beyond color changes. That means for Jinies like Duckiji, you can get an adorably fluffy (think chonkier) version, or the sleeker, slightly taller Duckiji. Finally, if your Jini has an Alpha Bloodline through hatching from Alpha boss eggs or an Alpha Bloodline Elixir, you have the chance to evolve your Jini to its Alpha Form, a fully upgraded and impressively powerful Jini.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/27/legendary-jini-fight-1793121288032.jpg
要收集这些 Jinies，您将使用 pod，它们都会捕获 Jinies 并提供不同的增益。太阳能吊舱最适合获得 Flora 和 Light 等级 Jinies，Prism Pod 提供 Jini Prismatic，而 Net 吊舱最适合水和 Wing 等级。这些只是您将在 Roco Kingdom 中使用的不同 Pod 的几个示例。

在 Carosia 的世界中，你会发现 Blossoms，你可以瞄准它们并进行战斗以捕获特定的 Jini。您最多可以与四名玩家组队，因为 Blossoms 可以提供捕捉高水平和高个人能力 Jinies 的机会，甚至是 Chromatic 和 Prismatic 变体。您还将参加洛克王国每周的 PvE 挑战。该测试的特色是与翼王的传奇 Boss 战斗，翼王是一个史诗般的飞马角色，拥有大胆的紫色翅膀，可以与 Pegasus 竞争。您还可以遇到帕利斯，一只凶猛的神秘狗，有着邪恶的尾巴和锋利的蓝色鳞片、爪子和角。击落它们会奖励 Jinies 和其他惊喜。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/27/catching-with-prism-pod-1793121327814.jpg
这只是《洛可王国》作为生物收集领域的最新产品所提供的深度游戏玩法和丰富场景的体验。现已在 Steam 上添加愿望清单《洛可王国》。

news.title: Elden Ring Movie Might Be Extremely Long, And It Could Have Twitch Integration Eventually
news.summary: New details have come to light about A24's Elden Ring movie, including how Amazon could be involved and its be

content.v: New details have come to light about A24's Elden Ring movie, including how Amazon could be involved and its beefy runtime.

According to Deadline , Amazon MGM is buying up the Elden Ring movie's Pay-1 streaming rights for numerous international markets in a deal potentially worth "tens of millions of dollars." The site reported that there could be "interesting activations" on Amazon's Twitch platform as part of the deal. A Pay-1 rights deal means the company gets exclusive rights to broadcast a movie after it ends its theatrical run and comes to home video.

Netflix, for example, paid Sony billions of dollars for a Pay-1 deal that includes the live-action Zelda movie . That was a global deal for many movies, though, and the report said Amazon MGM is booking an international deal specifically for the Elden Ring movie. It remains to be seen where the Elden Ring movie could stream after it wraps up in theaters.
The Elden Ring movie finished filming earlier this year and Industrial Light & Magic is now working on post-production efforts ahead of the movie's March 2028 release in theaters.

The film is based on From Software's game and was written and directed by Alex Garland, but the story details are being kept secret. Kit Connor is playing the lead, and the movie will apparently feature "battles between his character and impressive monsters and dragons."

The script is so secretive that A24 is reportedly booking flights for its staffers to potential international rights-buyers instead of sending the script digitally to ensure an A24 staffer is in the room as the script is being read. Additionally, the report said the script is at least 180 pages, meaning the film could stretch to a mighty three hours.
It was also reported that Elden Ring could become a movie franchise if the film does well, but no sequel plans are officially set yet.
In addition to Connor, the Elden Ring movie will star Cailee Spaeny, Ben Whishaw, Tom Burke, Jonathan Pryce, and Nick Offerman.
Finally, the Deadline report backed up the earlier rumor that the Elden Ring movie cost as much as $200 million to produce , making it A24's most expensive film ever.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/19/forever-1789805930640.png

World of Warcraft Forever launches a week from today, and while the game will have a huge swath of content available on day one, there will be new content continually added to the game. But how frequently should fans expect new content to arrive? It sounds like Blizzard is willing to take things a little slower than in the modern version of World of Warcraft.

In a recent interview with IGN , World of Warcraft Forever principal game designer Kris Zierhut, said Forever will employ a slower cadence than Midnight's aggressive eight-week content cycle: "We're fairly convinced the correct [update] rate is something closer to once every four months or 17 weeks or three times a year."

This is in contrast with the modern version of World of Warcraft, which has had an aggressive update cadence since Dragonflight launched in 2022. And while that approach has meant players of the modern version of the game have something new every couple of months, some have said the updates often feels rushed, with bugs and repeated content. We've all done some form of invasions several times in the last couple of years, after all.

Zierhut did say that Blizzard experimented with a faster update schedule in Season of Discovery, an experimental Classic game mode that came out in 2023, but "we cut it down to closer to that eight week or 10 week schedule. It felt way, way, way too fast."

But by going with a four month update schedule, Forever will also avoid the content droughts that some older expansions were infamous for. There have been times in WoW's history where the game didn't have new content for a year at a time, like in Warlords of Draenor, where patch 6.2, which included Hellfire Citadel, lasted for 13 months before the prepatch update for Legion.
Zierhut acknowledged this as well, saying: "We've played around with different rates of releasing content and going six or eight months without new stuff always feels bad. We know that."

Just because World of Warcraft patches will be released in four-month intervals, it doesn't necessarily mean you'll have to wait four months for something new to do. Zierhut also told me that the team may timegate some content, saying "one nuance on that is we do plan on making content that unlocks in between. So you might have patches with major releases four months apart, but there may be things that unlock two or three months in or one month into that."

The idea there is to ease players into content, rather than overwhelming them with everything all at once. Zierhut continued: "It's not just patch day comes [around], here's a content fire hose, and now we're silent for four months. A lot of that is, 'hey, there's a time event calendar that gradually unlocks things and opens them up over those four months' to give things a little bit more life instead of that all at once effect."

Only time will tell if this middle ground between rapid updates and slow updates will pay off, but according to the roadmap that Blizzard released at BlizzCon, Forever will have its first major update sometime in spring 2027. So, if that four-month timeline that Blizzard is targeting pays off, WoW Forever should have a fresh round of new content sometime in March.
While you wait for the game to launch, check out more on Blizzard's plan for World of Warcraft Forever .

news.title: “很多玩家不想扮演怪物”——《魔兽世界》永恒首席设计师进一步解释了为什么添加 Skyborne
news.summary: World of Warcraft Forever has its full launch a week from now on November 4, but ahead of time, Blizzard princ

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/19/forever-1789805930640.png

World of Warcraft Forever has its full launch a week from now on November 4, but ahead of time, Blizzard principal game designer Kris Zierhut shared a little bit of insight on why the new Skyborne race was added to the game.

When I asked Zierhut about Skyborne's addition, he told me that the goal was to add more elves to the game but to maintain the faction balance in the process. "We knew that we wanted to bring in more of the elves into the game. We know they're the most popular races in World of Warcraft historically. And in particular, the current alliance and Horde races from the Classic Era have the unfortunate feature that they tend to cause a faction imbalance," he told me.

As for why Blizzard needed to add elves specifically, it's because there's a segment of the player base that doesn't want to play some of WoW's more unique races. Zierhut explained, "There's a certain... a lot of players who don't want to play a monster, to put it really honestly. They don't want to be an Orc or a Troll or a Tauren or Undead. They want to have something that looks prettier. It's not everybody."

There are other possibilities for elves in Azeroth, like the Blood Elves, but the Forever team doesn't want to step on the retail team's toes. Elsewhere in the interview, I asked about Silvermoon, the home of the Blood Elves, and Zierhut referenced that, saying, "You mentioned Silvermoon, and this is a story that Retail had recently told, and we didn't want to get in each other's way of telling that story. We want to give them time to let their Silvermoon story breathe and do everything they wanted with it. And then once they were done with it, we could maybe then go visit Silvermoon."
So, it sounds like there's a chance that the Blood Elves could come to the game in the future, but for now, players will just have to make do with the Skyborne if they want a Horde elf race.

Ahead of Forever coming out next week, Blizzard has also detailed how often players can expect new updates , which will be added slower than the quick eight-week patch cycle of the modern game. Zierhut has also told me that the Forever team is looking at visiting some of the locations we've been to in expansions, like Northrend and Pandaria , in future updates.

news.title: 韩国政客敦促总统玩《现代战争4》以了解潜在入侵的“破坏性”
news.summary: A South Korean politician has urged the country's President to play Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 to grasp th

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/15/ss-ee5f6b6aebe4dc9e86b49c4e309d361b132df308-1920x1080-1792058059953.jpg
A South Korean politician has urged the country's President to play Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 to grasp the potential devastation of a North Korean invasion.

In a report from Korean outlet The Herald Business , politician Han Dong-hoon urged President Lee Jae-myung to play Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 to grasp how catastrophic things could be if the country was ill-equipped to defend against a North Korean invasion. He noted that the country should be actively preparing for any kind of situation, rather than simply hoping it never happens. He also pushed back against critiques of the game depicting an active all-out war between the two countries, believing that it should be a wake-up call to assess whether or not they're prepared for something like that to happen.
"I hope the image of a Seoul reduced to ashes in the game remains in the realm of fiction," he said.

In Modern Warfare 4, the game opens with a group of South Korean soldiers patrolling the city streets before an EMP takes out all power in the area. The North Korean army then attacks the city with a barrage of missiles before air-dropping soldiers and launching offensive measures through a series of tunnels. It's pure chaos, not unlike the surprise Russian invasion of America in the original Modern Warfare 2 from 2009.

Half of Modern Warfare 4's story focuses on South Korean forces trying to push the North Korean opposition back, despite being hopelessly outmatched and overpowered, partially thanks to a groundbreaking new technology that can wipe out defenses in the blink of an eye. The story also feels oddly timed, as reports last week claimed that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un had fallen into a coma or even outright died .

These reports have been denied and countered, but the comparison to the game came as Kim Jong Un's sister, Kim Yo Jong, made threats against South Korea . In Modern Warfare 4, there's a familial power struggle within North Korean leadership, which ends with the Supreme Leader's sister taking command and unleashing war on South Korea. Given the timing of the real-life situation and the release of Modern Warfare 4 last week, it was hard for fans not to see eerie similarities between reality and the game's fictional story.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 also has an entire mode set in the DMZ , a real-world location that sits on the border of North and South Korea. In the game, the player explores this environment to complete missions, extract loot, and learn additional lore about the game's story. IGN gave Modern Warfare 4 a 7/10 , noting that the game's multiplayer feels a bit too familiar, but the campaign elevates the larger package: "Multiplayer may not quite hit the mark, but a great campaign ensures Modern Warfare 4's place as one of Call of Duty’s better recent entries," reads an excerpt from our review.

news.title: Nvidia 和 AMD 向 Meta 投资数十亿美元，两家公司相互怂恿在人工智能上加大投入
news.summary: What's $3 billion to a trillion-dollar company?

content.v: This week both AMD and Nvidia have announced partnerships with Meta, securing both collabs and billions of dollars. All three companies are heavily invested in AI, and these deals are only more fuel for the fire.

Nvidia just announced its deal with Meta to "expand their partnership on Muse and the Muse family of models", and Meta, in turn, will expand Vera Rubin and Vera CPU deployment, as well as deploy Nvidia's Spectrum X Ethernet networking and BlueField-4 DPUs. Though Meta was probably buying all that stuff anyways, right?

Nvidia also said it was "considering other technological collaborations, including Nvidia OpenShell Reference Architecture to strengthen agency security and Nvidia Sentry for monitoring, structured, unstructured and graph data processing."

Importantly, Nvidia is also investing $3 billion into Meta. Money that may go elsewhere in Meta under a wholly different account book, but ultimately, Meta is spending a large amount of money on AI hardware from Nvidia. You see what's happening here? Both companies are spending big with one another.

One day after this announcement, AMD too declared its partnership with Meta, saying that it would be collaborating on CPU, GPU, networking, systems, and software for Meta's AI infrastructure. AMD also announced that its Helio rackscale solution would be powering Meta's "leading frontier models and services" and that AMD is the "compute engine of choice for Muse and AMD technologies provide Day-0 support for leading Meta models".
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kjtquRwKv5dLr2fqHMkE3A-1920-80.jpg
To top this off, AMD is investing $1 billion in Meta.
In total, that's $4 billion from both companies into Meta, with Meta announcing how it would be spending its money on each respective company.

AI is huge for all three companies, with Nvidia becoming the world's first $5 trillion company thanks to the technology, and all three companies will want to perpetuate the growth of AI for that reason.

The AI bubble hasn't burst yet, but it did see a $1 trillion decline just a few weeks ago, and the Chinese AI market lost trillions just this week. One could read further investment as a way to keep the bubble floating for a while longer, or just one in a line of many steps from all three companies to get a foot in the door once the AI boom settles. A bubble popping could help gamers eventually get lower-priced memory, but so much of the world's economy is wrapped up in it that it's hard to say just how wide the reverberations would be, for these three companies or the rest of the world. It won't be good.

The Wall Street Journal argues AI is "becoming the biggest economic bet in US history". It shows AI spending is significantly bigger, as a percentage of annual infrastructure spending, than telecom and fiber, highways, electric, railroads, and even canals way back in the 1800s. One has to wonder what would happen if that investment suddenly lost its value.

And even now, the negative impacts of AI is hitting gamers with the memory crisis , where AI is sucking up so much memory that the average gamer has to pay more and more for less capacious memory. And it doesn't just stop at memory. Graphics cards and SSDs have only gotten worse in the pricing department over the last year, and as long as the AI buildout continues, and memory struggles to keep up, that's unlikely to change soon.

news.title: 《龙与地下城》：《魔兽世界》的职业设计师“将尽可能多的”MMO 内容融入其中，这样即使是资深桌游玩家也能体验到新的东西
news.summary: The upcoming book introduces dozens of new subclasses, spells, and more to D&D's ruleset.

content.v: James Wyatt, the principal game designer and project lead designer of the upcoming Dungeons & Dragons: World of Warcraft book was already running games in Azeroth long before he took on the project. For him, the fun of bringing WoW to the table is not to ignore the flexibility of D&D but to embrace it.

"Part of the beauty of playing D&D in the world of Azeroth is that you can do things in D&D that you can't do in a digital game because the options haven't been programmed for you," he said in a recent presentation attended by PC Gamer.

On November 12, you'll be able to see how Wyatt and the other designers mixed the two RPGs by "paraphrasing" the MMO into the tabletop ruleset. But Wyatt and senior game designer Ben Petrisor gave us a peek into how their approach affects the classes you can play in D&D: WoW.

WoW's classes are thematically similar to D&D's, and that's part of what makes the collaboration so fitting. However, WoW's classes have to fit into restrictive roles, like a tank or a healer, that don't really exist in D&D, so the D&D: WoW designers decided to return to some of the class customization that was introduced with 2020's Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

Paladins won't have to give up their usual kit when they invest in WoW's holy specialization, for example. Wyatt explained that a lot of the unique abilities and talents WoW classes have access to have been translated into options players can incorporate into their characters. A holy paladin in D&D: WoW will still smite their foes into piles of ashes but they'll also have stronger ways to heal their allies than they normally would.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SoKUqv8gjMWkmDUHpHKX8T-1920-80.jpg

The same goes for classes like wizard that can pick up the Fingers of Frost feat at level 4 to lean harder into mastering frost-based spells like a frost mage would in the MMO. Beast master rangers can see what it's like to have a pet with its own weapon mastery on top of your own, emulating the tight bond WoW hunters have with their companions. There are dozens of new subclasses, spells, and additions to the core D&D classes like these, each pulling directly from the most iconic parts of WoW.
"We really crammed as much of the impactful talents across each WoW class into this book," Petrisor said.

Not only can you play WoW's unique hero classes—death knight, demon hunter, and evoker—you can experiment with new classes that Blizzard hasn't touched: Everyone who misses the early days of WoW when shamans could stand on the frontlines as magical warriors can pick up the barbarian subclass in D&D: WoW and channel their rage into elemental storms. Even bard, a class that was only an April Fool's joke in WoW, is fully playable in D&D: WoW.
The goal, Petrisor said, was to pull the restraints off of D&D's classes so that everyone, no matter which game you're most familiar with, can try something new.

"Even if you're coming into this without a lot of familiarity to WoW-specific classes, and you kind of want to just hit the ol' reliable button you'll still have an expanded experience and new and fun stuff to play with," he said.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zfNvdQGjjww96paMnsnnAQ-1920-80.jpg

Petrisor explained how the limitations of publishing a single, physical book were really the biggest hurdle when it came to imagining all the ways the two worlds could collide. But just like Wyatt stressed in the first preview presentation I attended, Petrisor has plenty of other ideas that he'd love to work on if people want more.

"If there's an IP that has the space to cover another book this is definitely one of them," he said. "So, the real challenge was—for me at least—while designing things was to try to find everything that would appease the fans of the game while also being options that would be interesting to D&D players and try to cram as many of those into this book as possible."

news.title: 看看 46 秒的《最终幻想 7：启示录》新游戏（和粉红陆行鸟）
news.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation aims to be the biggest chapter in the remake trilogy, not only in the number of reg

content.v: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation aims to be the biggest chapter in the remake trilogy, not only in the number of regions players can explore, but also in verticality. Square Enix had previously shown off how the game's cast will be able to skydive into new locations on the world map, but for a taste of just how much verticality the game will have in certain areas, you can check out this new slice of gameplay set in the Midgar region, which features Cloud exploring a massive chasm underneath the city--and atop a pink chocobo, too.

While that's a lot of empty space to fly through, it's still impressive just how much of it there is. Of course, this is only one part of the game, and there's no guarantee every region will have caverns this massive. But considering how Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth greatly expanded on the environments of Final Fantasy 7 Remake with its open-world design, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is expected to raise the bar by increasing the size of the world around Cloud and the rest of the gang. Revelation will also introduce Cid's iconic airship, the Highwind, which will serve as the gang's base of operations, and unfortunately, Chadley is there too.
All that "planetary-scale" content will take up a lot of space on your PC or console, with game director Naoki Hamaguchi estimating the game will be "around" 200GB.

One of the big games to look forward to next year, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will launch on April 8, 2027. It's estimated that a complete playthrough could take as long as 100 hours--something Hamaguchi had done 46 times already when last we spoke to him--and two post-launch expansions starring Vincent Valentine and Sephiroth will follow in the game's wake.

"My time with the final chapter of the Final Fantasy 7 remake trilogy clearly shows that the team at Square Enix has plenty of story left to tell. We’ll just have to wait until April for the rest of the Revelation(s)," Jason Fanelli wrote after going hands-on with Final Fantasy 7 Revelation earlier this month.

Square Enix 资深人士表示，未来的开发人员需要“掌握人工智能的使用”，但人性化仍然至关重要
news.summary: "Humans need to be involved in the initial step of turning zero into one."

content.v: AI's a touchy subject in the development industry, but in other areas it's a lot less controversial—take Japan, for instance, which is embracing the technology a lot more than audiences in the West are. That's not to say there isn't any push back at all , mind.

Still, an example of how there's more of a positive spin on it overseas comes courtesy of a Famitsu interview (translated here by Automaton ) where seasoned JRPG devs from Square Enix seem broadly positive on the tech—and are repeating some oft-heard talking points that I, at least, am personally very bored of, even if I wouldn't dismiss them out of hand.

Hiromichi Tanaka, who worked on many Final Fantasy games during his tenure (which ended in 2012), says that the creations of the future "will definitely come down to how well people can master the use of AI." Yoshinori Kitase (also a veteran, and current producer on Final Fantasy 7: Revelation) concurs, saying: "major game companies will need to rethink their development methods to avoid being swept away by this wave."

Kitase points out that we've already had an increased wave of indie games from the popularisation of accessible game engines, and "when you add support from new tools and technologies on top of that, even people with limited experience can more easily make games."

We have seen a touch of that in all of these decompiled games , but there's also the fact that people with limited experience are also able to just up and steal ideas easier, too. And I'm not talking about a corporate aversion to piracy, here. The developers of Moonlighter recently had to yank their ReVamp demo from Steam because it was getting cloned—that's an indie dev having its hard work copy-pasted.

Kitase does at least acknowledge that people don't tend to find purely AI-generated or cloned slop tasteful, though: "Humans need to be involved in the initial step of turning zero into one," a turn of phrase he uses to describe the human creative spark and original ideas. "That will never change. The next generation of creators absolutely needs the ability to turn zero into one."

Tanaka adds that this'll turn the industry into a "competition of ideas". Which is a nice fantasy on paper, though I'm not entirely sure it's panning out that way in practice—as mentioned above, indie developers, already on rocky ground in an unkind industry where discoverability is a nightmare, are at risk of either having their games cloned or drowned in a sea of AI slop .

news.title: 《仙剑4重制版》主角形象引争议：幼态网红脸审美？
news.summary: 《仙剑奇侠传四 重制版》官宣12月5日公布发售日，然而因角色建模更新再度引发玩家热议

content.v: 《仙剑奇侠传四 重制版》官宣12月5日公布发售日，然而因角色建模更新再度引发玩家热议。尽管官方采用虚幻引擎5进行了全面视觉升级，但玩家反馈呈现明显两极分化，云天河、韩菱纱等核心角色的外观改动均遭到不同程度批评。
原作中云天河是在青鸾峰长大的“野人”，带有粗粝、纯粹的少年野性。但重制版预告中的云天河被不少玩家批评“幼态”过重，另有玩家指出其“面部缺乏特点，少了点原版的灵动劲儿”。

韩菱纱的批评集中在服装和脸型。有玩家直接对服装配色提出质疑：“菱纱的脸挺好看的，但是为什么衣服也选这种又深又丑的紫色？”。原作韩菱纱的劲装以红、蓝等鲜明色调为主，重制版偏深的紫色被认为偏离了角色原本的视觉印象。脸型方面，重制版将她的脸做得更圆润，有玩家形容为“多了点婴儿肥”，虽然“更漂亮了”，但“少了点俏皮”，与原作机敏狡黠的气质产生了距离。发型也从双马尾改为单侧编发，同样被部分玩家视为“网红化”的改动。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272245597017.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272246009402.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272246011081.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272244393997.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272244447257.png
这些批评的共同指向，并非单纯反对“变好看”，而是认为高清化在提升细节的同时，磨掉了原版角色身上那些不精致却有辨识度的特质。原版《仙剑四》受限于2007年的技术，建模棱角分明，但角色的气质反而因此显得鲜明——云天河的野、韩菱纱的灵、柳梦璃的清冷，都建立在一种“不完美但准确”的视觉语言之上。重制版用UE5将这些角色推向更光滑、更符合当代审美的方向，却让一部分老玩家感到“认不出是谁”。

content.v: 《刺客信条4：黑旗 记忆重置》是育碧对2013年经典之作《刺客信条4：黑旗》的一次现代重制，游戏已于7月9日正式发售，支持中配。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272247188163.png
据PushSquare报道，育碧现已推出《刺客信条4：黑旗 记忆重置》1.0.8版本补丁。官方确认，这是本作上线之后最后一次大型内容更新，未来只会推出BUG修复、体验优化类小补丁。
具体更新内容如下：
更新大小
Xbox Series X|S: 15.5 GB
PlayStation®5: 4.5 GB
PC: 4.3 GB
Steam: 2.1 GB
更新亮点
新游戏+
再度扬帆（一次、又一次、又一次、又一次、又一次）
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/origin_202610272247408746.gif
一次次重返加勒比海，开启新的探索。“新游戏+”终于来了！在保留已有收获的同时，再次踏上爱德华·肯威的传奇旅程，探索辽阔海域，重新集结你的船员！
可继承的内容
爱德华的所有工具、升级、已解锁武器及饰品。
寒鸦号的所有升级、已解锁的指挥官能力及宠物。
指挥官不会直接出现在船上，需要重新招募。
物品栏中的所有金钱、材料及交易品。
新游戏+将引入一种新货币。
任务相关物品将被移除。
所有已解锁的可自定义服装及其自定义选项。
藏身处的建设进度、增益效果及艺术收藏。
肯威的舰队中的所有船只。
不过，由于地图迷雾将会重置，你需要重新攻占各座要塞。
百科条目，包括已获取及已完成的各张藏宝图。
从商店购买的物品。
每开启一次新游戏+，海域都会变得更加危险。精英士兵更常出现，最高等级的船只也会开始在海上巡逻。每次重启旅程，难度都会提升。你最多可以开启五次新游戏+，推进至“新游戏+++++”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272247512598.jpg
我们还为新游戏+加入了一种专属货币。你可以通过完成挑战，以及搜刮此前已开启过的宝箱来积累这种货币，也可以在杂货店将银圆兑换为葡萄牙元。使用葡萄牙元，你可以购买新游戏+专属的新服装与物品。原本可用银圆购买的物品不受影响，仍可在原来的商人处以相同价格购买。
噩梦难度
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272247596302.jpg
没有重来的机会，也没有手下留情。噩梦难度将让《黑旗 记忆重置》化为一场残酷的生存之战，每次交锋都可能成为你的最后一战。敌人的反应更快，攻击更加致命，片刻犹豫也可能让你付出代价。加勒比海依旧美丽，但在海浪之下、地平线之外，死亡正等待着毫无准备的冒险者。
陆上战斗
敌人造成的伤害提高至原来的1.8倍。
招架的判定时间窗口缩短。
敌人攻击时不再出现白色闪光提示。
远程敌人的射击频率提高。
关闭防止被一击击杀的保护机制。
这是影响最显著的变化：即使玩家仍有大量生命值，游戏也不会再阻止其被瞬间击杀。请务必格外小心子弹与爆炸物。
潜行
敌人发现玩家所需的时间大幅缩短。
敌人的调查时间延长。
当玩家以快于行走的速度移动时，敌人能够听到其动静。
爱德华在高处保持隐蔽所需的垂直高度差，由至少高于敌人4米提高至6米。
航海
所有船只造成的伤害提高。
活动
水下鲨鱼造成的伤害提高。
海胆与水母造成的伤害翻倍。
氧气条消耗速度加快。
所有捕鱼活动中遭遇的野生动物造成的伤害提高。
隐藏的社区宝箱！
我们藏好了新的社区宝箱，等你来发现。其中一些宝箱还包含应社区玩家请求加入的特别奖励。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272248103355.jpg
既然大家都是寻宝高手，这次我们便提高了寻找难度，也不会提供轻易就能猜透的提示。祝你们好运，海盗们！
更多亮点
新增击倒动作
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/origin_202610272248206512.gif
我们重新加入了原版游戏中的击倒动画，包括袖剑、徒手、单剑及枪剑击倒动作。

news.title: Steam Next 盛宴被污水淹没。这 50 个演示消除了噪音
news.summary: The October Edition of Steam Next Fest was, unsurprisingly, a complete mess . What was once a fun week-long fe

content.v: The October Edition of Steam Next Fest was, unsurprisingly, a complete mess . What was once a fun week-long festival of early game demos has become a dumping ground for vibe-coded AI slop, making it increasingly hard to find and wishlist good games. And if you weren't bothered by playing a game demo that was hastily cobbled together, the sheer volume--around 7,100 game demos were available this time--of what was on offer made Next Fest a nightmare to navigate. So what's a person to do when Valve's own storefront lacked the tools to separate the wheat from the chaff? Be patient, and look at the general consensus; that's what.

While Next Fest is over, many of those games' demos are still readily available to download and play. The Top 50 Next Fest demos for October 2026 span a wide variety of genres and themes, and the list shows a few trends. Social, co-op, and friendslop games rose to the top, as people couldn't get enough of multiplayer chaos in party games like Worst Class Ever, while Fart Together offered physics-driven goofiness and intestinal turbulence.

Niche management and shopkeeper sims also attracted players, with Questing Goose Studio's Probably Stolen and Victorian-gothic gem-cutting sim Abyssal Lapidary proving popular. Anyone looking for low-effort experiences will likely enjoy desktop companion games like Character House, and anticipated sequels like ArcheAge Chronicles drew big player numbers. One thing to note is that some of these games--like Teach My Little Sister How To Drive --do have AI disclosures attached, which you can filter for .

The list below should be a solid starting point for checking out game demos that drew massive buzz, but waiting a week to see what's worth playing based on popularity alone isn't exactly ideal. Valve hasn't said anything about how the third and final Next Fest of the year was a mess, despite the public outcry, even though the number of games for this instance of the event almost doubled compared with the June 2026 edition. If that trend continues, next year's Next Fest in February could be even more difficult to explore.

Beyond Next Fest, Steam has also confirmed the dates for several upcoming sales and themed promotions for the rest of 2026 and the first half of 2027. The Steam Winter Sale 2026 will run from December 17 – January 4, 2027, and right now, you can stock up on horror games through Steam Scream V Fest.
Steam Next Fest October 2026: The Most-Played Demos
Ordered by number of unique players during the week-long event.

content.v: 此前因给《影之刃零》打出3星（M站折算60分）而陷入争议的Eurogamer编辑Emma Kent再次发文，披露了她在评测这款游戏时遇到的一些“非常奇怪的情况”。
《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
Emma Kent指出，在评测过程中有两个主要因素影响了她的体验。
首先，S-Game官方对评测者提出了严格的叙事限制，要求他们不要讨论游戏中的很大一部分剧情，甚至明确表示不能剧透序章的过场动画。这导致她无法在评测中充分赞扬游戏后期一些很酷的叙事手法，她对此感到“非常遗憾”。

news.title: Nvidia 可能尚未停产 RTX 5090，但一位 AIB 合作伙伴表示，它无法获得制造该卡所需的零件
news.summary: And RTX 5090s weren't cheap before.

content.v: Nvidia's RTX 5090 has been a subject of much speculation recently, as it was rumoured to be discontinued last month when it vanished from the company's official marketplace, only for Nvidia to confirm it wasn't discontinued . The plot has thickened, though, as AIB partners—the companies actually designing and manufacturing RTX 50 series graphics cards—suggest even they can't get their hands on the parts required to make the card.

This is according to an Nvidia AIB partner who spoke to YouTuber Der8auer . They say, "No, Nvidia did not inform us that RTX 5090 is EOL. But currently we cannot purchase GB202 [the GPU] together with 32 GB GDDR7 as [a] complete set, and we also don't know if ordering will be possible again in the future."
The unnamed board partner clarifies that in previous shortages, they could place backorders with Nvidia, but this is "currently not possible anymore."

This is all to say that this AIB partner is unable to get the GPU and memory required to make the RTX 5090, and doesn't know when that supply issue will be fixed. Though this isn't the card being discontinued, for many partners, not getting the GPU and VRAM is as good as doing so.
Whether it's the GPU or the memory that's causing the biggest headache isn't specified, though in the current context, one can assume it's likely both to some degree.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dMHeoyF85ptrkZLthKfisE-1920-80.jpg

As of right now, companies are reliant on GPU and VRAM bundles from Nvidia before they can make their own cards. There have previously been r umours that Nvidia would stop bundling its GPUs and VRAM together , but even if it did that, this would only partly solve the issue of the memory crisis for Nvidia. Those who might have been able to buy just the GPU would still be subject to a price squeeze on the VRAM when trying to source it direct from one of the major memory manufacturers.

Der8auer also spoke to an RTX 5090 cooler manufacturer who said, "Two of our partners already reduced quite much the order forecast for RTX 5090 based heatsinks in Q1 2027, when compare[d] with Q3 2026."
"For Q2 2027, until now we still did not receive any order for RTX 5090 model heatsinks from our partners."

Nvidia still remains steadfast in saying the card has not been discontinued, though it acknowledges that limited supply chain capacity has led to a "somewhat constrained" output. Its German branch says, "Nvidia will continue to ship it, and this is very important."

The RTX 5090 (an already expensive card at its previous MSRP of $2,000) has been prohibitively expensive for months. It's so pricey, in fact, that we stopped tracking it in our graphics card price watch . It has been incredibly difficult to find any of the cards available from reputable sellers at even reasonable prices (with some listed for upwards of $8,000 right now ) and therefore we could never recommend actually picking one up. Though it may not be officially discontinued, it seems like the likelihood of picking one up soon at a decent price is getting slimmer and slimmer by the day.

news.title: 截止日期：来世处理让你将道德掌握在自己手中，并判断谁应该得到永恒的救赎或诅咒
news.summary: Playing music too loud on the subway? Believe it or not, straight to jail.

content.v: I've always thought that I'm a particularly good judge of character, so I was happy to put my theory to the test with Deadline: Afterlife Processing's new demo where you play as some corporate angel judging whether the souls of the recently deceased should go upstairs or downstairs (I think we all know what that means).

Deadline's demo starts like most stints in corporations do, with paperwork. I'm not entirely sure whether I signed my soul away, but I was sad to hear I won't be getting time off anytime soon. After I was done with all the bureaucracy it was time to get to work.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RAnQeqb4X8gp4JVfsUaGeE-1920-80.jpg

First thing's first, you need to clock in, every minute counts and you don't want to be late for work when your boss is either the creator of the universe or someone powerful enough to force the deceased into a suit and tie. The rest of my work day played out pretty normally: I'd grab a coffee, sift through some notes, and use this giant machine which can read the souls of humans and extrapolate key details of their life. This is what I used to decide if people had been naughty or nice.

Most of the souls that crossed my paths were pretty obvious. They'd either donated their lifesavings to charity or punched a random old lady in the street—figuring out who deserves to go to heaven or hell isn't exactly rocket science in these cases. There were, however, a couple of scenarios that had me stop and ponder the ethics of a given situation.

One soul that came to me on the second day of my job had killed a stranger on the subway. Now, this is obviously bad, you shouldn't kill people, but the stranger had been playing their music obnoxiously loud, no headphones or anything. That's not to say they had it coming, but I can't say that I don't at least understand where this person was coming from. I gave them the benefit of the doubt and sent them upstairs—hopefully the music isn't too loud up there.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ixjHmhLvR8uygWj47M7f9F-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QzZNrKoXKhay8PmzwQss3F-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/g5iBER9ZREqQg56JkEgw3F-1920-80.jpg

A second case that had me momentarily stumped involved a grumpy old man who never attended or donated money to the neighbourhood block parties. After thinking on it for all of one second I decided to send him upwards as well. You see, I also hate block parties, so not attending them is the right decision in my book.

I stand by my decisions, every single one of them. I think my nebulous boss liked them as well, because after a few days I was offered a fulltime position. This is when everything started getting weird.

I can't say what's wrong for sure as the demo ended not long after I was promoted but after finding a soul that could not be quantified I was sent down to storage to log it and store it for the foreseeable future. It was here that I encountered a soul orb that began glowing strangely and seemed as if it was trying to follow me out of the room. But managing the strange ethereal glow of abandoned souls isn't in my job description—I checked—so legally speaking that isn't my problem.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dmLfcTEceHMYUpsciYxiDT-1920-80.jpg

news.title: 作为微软大规模改组的一部分，Xbox 员工有资格被买断
news.summary: Microsoft has announced a new program called the Voluntary Exit Offer that it's extending to thousands of work

content.v: Microsoft has announced a new program called the Voluntary Exit Offer that it's extending to thousands of workers at the company, including people on the Xbox team.
Microsoft is doing this to shed employees, but the messaging is that a program like this could be appealing to someone who was already thinking about leaving and can now do so with a pay package.

Microsoft shared the high-level details of the Voluntary Exit Offer on its blog , and Bloomberg had more insight. The report said 60,000 workers are eligible for the Voluntary Exit Offer, and this works out to more than 25% of Microsoft's entire workforce.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Xbox-2.png?w=636

Bloomberg reported that Xbox is one of the divisions of Microsoft whose employees can leave the company via the Voluntary Exit Offer, along with Windows, Copilot, and finance teams. The report said people working on Microsoft's efforts in data centers, sales, marketing, cyber security, and quantum computing are not eligible.

Microsoft made this announcement just two days before it releases its next earnings report on October 28. The technology giant is spending hundreds of billions of dollars in its massive AI push, and many in the investment community have questioned if that level of capital expenditure makes sense.

In April this year, Microsoft offered a Voluntary Retirement Program, and it offered severance pay, ongoing stock vesting, and extended health benefits. About 33% of eligible workers took that deal. Mass layoffs came in July, affecting nearly 5,000 people, including major cuts at Xbox. Terms of the new Voluntary Exit Offer are not available, but a spokesperson told Bloomberg that those who take the offer will receive benefits similar to a severance package.

For Xbox specifically, it was reported that further layoffs could be announced in October , with another round set for November, and then another in January 2027. However, The Verge's Tom Warren said the October layoffs at Xbox are not happening this month, but will occur later. Xbox has been undergoing a "reset" under the leadership of CEO Asha Sharma, and this has included mass layoffs, studio closures, and game cancellations, among other dramatic moves.

These changes are happening at Microsoft amid huge surges in revenue and profitability for the company. For the latest period, Microsoft reported $90 billion in revenue (up 18%) and a profit of $35.8 billion (up 22%). As mentioned, the newest data will be revealed on October 28, so keep checking back for more.
CEO Satya Nadella addressed the seemingly discordant nature of cutting staff so massively at a time when the company is making so much money. In a memo , he said, "This is the enigma of success."

news.title: 日本人乐疯了！媒体玩《昭和米国物语》笑到肚子疼
news.summary: 近日，日本知名游戏媒体4Gamer试玩了由铃空游戏开发的新作《昭和米国物语》。

content.v: 近日，日本知名游戏媒体4Gamer试玩了由铃空游戏开发的新作《昭和米国物语》。
本次试玩版提供了“故事＆战斗”、“休息＆成长”等多个场景，这款自2022年公布起就因极其离谱的设定而备受瞩目的游戏，再次向玩家展示了其独一无二的“整活”实力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271551291718.jpg
游戏的背景设定在虚构的昭和66年：日本凭借强大的经济实力买下了大半个美国，并在文化上全面主导，诞生了融合日美特征的“昭和美国”。
在这里，自由女神像穿上了和服，金门大桥挂上了巨大日式灯笼，好莱坞变成了“新横滨”。
然而，“大灾厄”突然降临，人类大多变成了僵尸。死而复生的女主角千草蝶子，为了寻找失踪的妹妹，踏上了横跨美国的公路之旅。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271551367140.jpg
试玩的核心是战斗系统。玩家可以通过轻（□）重（△）攻击组合出丰富的连招，在按键顺序中衍生出高伤害或打断敌人动作的技能。玩家可以装备指虎、武士刀、美国国旗甚至电钻等多种近战武器，以及两种远程枪械。
战斗中最关键的是资源管理。攻击或受击会积攒“怒气槽（HG）”，转化为点数后可用于强化攻击、切换武器攻击或释放武器奥义。同时，“体力（ST）”不仅影响行动，还会直接影响防御力。体力越低，受到的伤害越高；停下行动或消耗怒气点数攻击可以恢复体力。这种机制鼓励玩家在攻防之间寻找平衡。当敌人被打破“Break”槽陷入僵直时，所受伤害将翻倍，并可以被主角华丽处决。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271551449044.jpg
让4Gamer编辑最为惊喜的是游戏无处不在的恶搞元素。在面对穿着昭和风体操服、涂着夸张涂料的敌对势力“勇士团”时，突然响起了极其熟悉的BGM——那竟然是《共和国战歌》（美国爱国歌曲，也是日本电器店友都八喜的经典店内BGM）。
这种强烈的反差和黑色幽默让编辑直呼“笑到肚子痛”，并将其比作“去掉了极道元素、塞满了搞笑桥段的《如龙》”。
在“休息＆成长”环节中，主角可以在专属列车“G-EX红莲特快”上休整。通过消耗探索获得的AP，玩家可以进行吃饭、锻炼、看漫画等活动，从而永久提升角色能力。
《昭和米国物语》预计将于2026年内发售，登陆PC、PS5及PS4平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271551544323.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271551559231.jpg

news.title: NS2模拟器成功运行独占游戏！画面效果曝光 支持PC
news.summary: 今日，开发者avvsky（ovvvsky）于社交平台公布消息，由其主导开发的Compound，宣称是全球第一款能够正常运行的任天堂Switch2模拟器…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272216003925.png
今日，开发者avvsky（ovvvsky）于社交平台公布消息，由其主导开发的Compound，宣称是全球第一款能够正常运行的任天堂Switch2模拟器，相关项目源码已经上传至GitHub。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272216083305.png
根据项目介绍，Compound采用纯C语言开发，定位兼顾Switch1与Switch2两代主机的模拟方案，使用Ballistic ARM64重编译器实现高性能JIT，原生支持Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、ARM64等多平台，自带GUI调试界面、内存追踪与代码热重载等专业调试工具。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272216188074.png
开发者在帖子附带截图展示成果：模拟器已经可以渲染出《马里奥网球 狂热》画面，角色模型、球场场景基本正常显示。不过作者着重强调，项目仍属于非常早期的实验版本，大量子系统还在开发中，包含不少临时的实验性补丁；但核心的指令执行、内存映射与图形渲染模块，已经实现基础可用。
本项目使用GPLv3开源协议，定位面向模拟器开发者、系统编程研究人员，用于硬件逆向与底层系统研究。需要注意，该模拟器属于非官方逆向工程产物，运行游戏需要游戏本体固件与ROM文件，存在版权风险，不建议普通玩家尝试。

news.title: 9.5!IGN分部盛赞《影之刃零》：只狼+忍龙+尼尔
news.summary: IGN巴西的《影之刃零》媒体评测文章今日正式解禁，给出了9.5分的高分。

content.v: IGN巴西的《影之刃零》媒体评测文章今日正式解禁，给出了9.5分的高分。
《影之刃零》 预售进行中 ！叠加金币至高省40元，每周抽10份免单，还送大作优惠券！
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610270947194543.png
IGN巴西的评测编辑表示，本作将《只狼》的弹反与破防、《忍者龙剑传》的连击以及《尼尔：机械纪元》的华丽视效完美融合。玩家需要高度专注，虽然不像魂系那么充满惩罚性，但极富挑战与爽快感。
游戏提供超过30种武器（远超同类游戏），每把武器都有完全不同的动作模组与机制；配合“影之武装”等特殊装备，让战斗策略不断推陈出新。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610270947271796.jpg
Boss战是游戏最大的亮点，数量庞大、演出极其壮观。优秀的阶段保存机制（在二阶段死亡无需重打一阶段）极大地提升了体验。击败Boss还能直接获得并使用其特色武器。
半开放世界融合了类魂与银河恶魔城元素。地图宏大且四通八达，由于“敌人不复活”的设定，游戏彻底移除了刷怪机制，迫使并鼓励玩家不断向前探索。丰富的支线任务不仅提供升级素材，还关系到最终结局。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610270947401405.png
IGN巴西表示：“最终，《影之刃零》让我感到极其满意，并超出了我的预期。见证这款游戏在开发过程中的不断成长，看到制作组在动作编排、场景设计、Boss战上投入的心血，以及对那些启发本作的作品的致敬，让我对S-Game未来的表现充满期待。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610270947534623.png

content.v: 在2026英雄联盟全球总决赛瑞士轮中，LPL赛区一号种子AL战队以0胜3负的战绩止步16强，成为LPL史上首支世界赛一场未胜的一号种子，创LPL史上最差成绩。
赛后AL英雄联盟 官方微博发文致歉广大粉丝。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610270933341180.jpg
原文如下：
很抱歉，AL在刚刚结束的瑞士轮比赛中落败，结束了本次2026全球总决赛的旅程。
在此，向所有支持AL的粉丝们郑重说一句：对不起。
我们知道，这句对不起改变不了比分，也换不回你们熬夜守候的那些夜晚。但我们不想用“已经尽力”来搪塞，也不想把这次失利包装成“成长的代价”。这一次，就是我们没有做好。
很遗憾没能用更远的征程回报这份陪伴，回望这一年，有起伏，有磨合，也有过让人眼前一亮的时刻。我们带着期待来到世界赛，却在最需要向前迈一步的时候，没能把最好的状态拿出来，也没能为LPL带来更多的胜利。
谢谢每一位专程到场、守在屏幕前、直到最后一刻还在为AL加油的召唤师，同时也接受所有恳切的批评。
AL的故事不会停在这里，等春天回来，我们会带着更好的自己，重新出发。

news.title: 《生化危机》系列官宣或将迎结局！不靠一款游戏讲完
news.summary: 公司围绕《生化危机》制定的首个十年计划已经完成

content.v: 卡普空高级执行董事竹内润在系列周年采访中透露，公司围绕《生化危机》制定的首个十年计划已经完成，并暗示这个横跨多部作品的主线故事可能在未来十年内迎来结局。他表示，结局不会只靠一款游戏讲完，但具体会推出多少部作品，目前没有说明。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271716581143.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271717401863.png

竹内润回顾，这一长期规划最早在《生化危机2：重制版》开发时期成形。当时卡普空确立了十年的品牌概念，但故事本身并非从一开始就完整规划，而是随着每一部新作逐步调整，这也让不同作品之间的线索整合变得困难。他同时谈到系列此前的几次转折：《生化危机4》放弃洋馆、转向村庄和越肩视角时曾遭遇内部阻力；《生化危机6》则被他形容为旧点子堆砌、缺少新鲜身份。真正让系列找回方向的是《生化危机7》，他受卡普空会长委托接手这个陷入困境的项目，目标就是让恐惧重新成为核心，第一人称视角则让恐怖感更直接。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610271717007837.png
2026年2月发售的《生化危机：安魂曲》被竹内润视为这一长期方向上的里程碑。游戏允许玩家在第一人称和第三人称之间切换，主角为新人格蕾丝与回归的里昂·肯尼迪。他还暗示《安魂曲》与《生化危机7》之间存在关联，并提到标题中的字母“q”代表数字9。按照他的说法，整个故事预计将在未来十年内走向收束。

news.title: NS2黑客重大突破！游戏文件能直接搬到PC了
news.summary: 该漏洞适用于Ver. 23.0.1固件，但未提供内核级权限。

content.v: 据Polygon报道，技术论坛GBAtemp上近期分享了一个针对Switch 2的新漏洞利用。它可以通过访问主机文件系统并操纵内存，把系统固件和游戏文件完整导出到PC。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/27/cas_auto/small_0_9105707.jpg
报道称，黑客此前已借助一款面向初学者的编程游戏《SmileBASIC4》来查看和修改Switch 2的文件系统，这次的新漏洞控制范围更大，文件系统里的内容都能被操作，导出游戏也在其中。该漏洞适用于Switch 2固件的Ver.23.0.1版本。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/27/cas_auto/small_0_9105708.jpg
对玩家来说，眼下还谈不上在PC上玩Switch 2游戏。报道明确指出，要等Switch 2模拟器开发出来，导出的游戏才可能运行；但文件能被导出，本身就让后续的改机和破解门槛降低了不少。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/10/27/cas_auto/small_0_9105709.jpg
报道同时给出了这次进展的边界：漏洞并未提供“内核级访问权限”，也就是还做不到对主机的完全控制。Polygon分析认为，这一发现将加速模拟器与逆向工程的尝试，也可能推动黑客继续往内核权限方向走。

news.title: 你就是赢不了——尽管《羊蹄之魂》销量数百万份，但据报道有 24 名员工被《Sucker Punch》解雇
news.summary: Are the "challenges in the market" in the room with us right now?

content.v: As we've noted before on this very site, there really is just no winning in the videogame industry , particularly under current conditions. Make an unsuccessful game? Make the kind of game you didn't want to make, but were pressured into? Layoffs. Make a successful game? Layoffs. Currently making a game? Believe it or not, layoffs.

As is the case with Ghost of Yōtei developer sucker punch, which has reportedly—per an internal email sent to Aftermath and confirmations from an ex-employee to the site—been hit with 24 layoffs, around a 10% reduction in staff.

This is despite the fact that Ghost of Yōtei, the studio's most recent game, was a commercial success: It sold 3.3 million copies in its opening month , making it the 11th-best selling game in the US in 2025. It continued to rake in the cash, hopping over 5 million copies in just a handful of months.

The email itself reads: "After carefully observing the challenges in the market and reviewing the team needs for our next project, we've decided to make some staffing reductions. Several positions across Sucker Punch will be eliminated as a result.

"We know this is a lot to take in, and we want to assure you that we did not make this decision lightly. We have given this a lot of attention and worked to support our affected colleagues during this transition as well as we can. … There's no getting around that this is a hard day. Next week we will go into more details about the future."

In—and I want to wrap this word up in air quotes here— fairness to Sony here, challenges in the market have been absolutely miserable. An AI bubble has sent everything tits-up for the foreseeable future, games are getting far more expensive to make , outpacing the prices at which they're sold, and Covid-19 overhiring didn't help .

And yet, part of me thinks you should be able to make a nearly top-10 selling videogame and probably be secure in your job for, like, a year at the very least. This doesn't smack as a sign of a healthy industry . Besides, it's not like you're seeing Sony's executive staff taking a pay cut.

news.title: 使用此技巧只需 85 美元即可在 PS5 上获取 GTA 6 终极版 - 仅限今天
news.summary: Today only, you can get a $100 PlayStation Store gift card for just $85 – and then use it to buy the Ultimate

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/27/untitled-design-5-1793107559234.png
Update Oct 27, 1pm ET: Unfortunately, this deal has sold out. I'll update this article if it comes back.

As a commerce editor at IGN, I’ve been on the lookout for the best possible deal on Grand Theft Auto 6 — almost certainly the biggest game of the year. Since no retailer is offering a direct discount on GTA 6, the best way I’ve found to save money on it is to buy a PlayStation or Xbox gift card when it’s discounted at Newegg.

Today only, Newegg has the best deal I’ve seen yet on a $100 PlayStation gift card . If you enter promo code GTWF2793 at checkout, you’ll save $15 — meaning you get $100 of PlayStation credit for $85 . That’s enough to buy you the Ultimate Edition of Grand Theft Auto 6, the edition most people are preordering .
$100 PlayStation Store Digital Gift Card for $85

This is almost certainly the biggest discount we’ll see on gift cards ahead of GTA 6's November 19 launch, and thus the best deal available. In other words: if you want the Ultimate Edition of GTA 6 and you want the best deal possible, now is the time to buy.

Once you buy the gift card (making double sure to use the promo code to get the deal), you should receive a code via email within an hour ( I just did it, and my code came six minutes after I placed the order ). You can redeem this code at the PlayStation Store for $100 in credit. To do so, just make sure you're signed in, and click your avatar in the upper right corner of the page. That will open a dropdown menu with the option "Redeem Code," where you can paste your code.
Now that you have your funds, head to the Grand Theft Auto 6 page (your choice of standard edition or ultimate edition ) and preorder the game. Then you’re all set.
Preorder Grand Theft Auto 6 - Ultimate Edition

What do you get with the ultimate edition? To quote Rockstar, it includes “an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story.” Here's a full rundown.
GTA 6 Ultimate Edition Includes:
Exclusive Vehicles & Storage
Extra Vehicle Content
Exclusive Weapons
Additional Missions & Activities
Cosmetics & Character Customization
You can find more info in our GTA 6 preorder guide .

While you can’t play the game until it comes out on November 19, you’ll be able to pre-load it onto your PS5 starting on November 12. That gives you a week to download it ahead of launch, so you don’t have to worry about slow network speeds once the game is available. Then, once November 19 rolls around, the game will unlock and you’ll be able to play the biggest game of the year.

If you'd rather have a physical copy, that's cool – but I don't expect any deals or discounts to be available anywhere on physical copies. It's also worth noting that Grand Theft Auto 6 is only available in digital form. While Rockstar will sell you a “physical copy” ( see it at Amazon ), all you actually get is a game box with a download code in it. No discs for the game are being printed. So if you do want to save $15, this deal on PlayStation Store credit is the one to buy.

others.title: 微软确认《使命召唤》终生收入突破 400 亿美元

content.v: It's been 22 years, 11 months, 28 days and counting since we were first graced with Call of Duty . Over those two decades the franchise has emerged as one of the most lucrative in videogame history, with Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announcing that it's passed the $40billion revenue mark.

Speaking of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's success, Sharma reflects : "One of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40 billion in lifetime franchise revenue. An incredible milestone. Congrats to the Activision team. And to the players, thank you for being with us."

One of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40B in lifetime franchise revenue. An incredible milestone. Congrats to the Activision team. And to the players, thank you for being with us. https://t.co/AlpXydEQIQ October 26, 2026

$40 billion in lifetime revenue places Call of Duty behind goliaths like Mario and Pokémon. It also means that Call of Duty, on average, has earned $4,762,472 a day, which is particularly terrifying if you ask me.

But how it got there is an entirely different question—one that can be answered by the ravenous appetite of consumers in the free market. Call of Duty: Black Ops 3 still sits at the top spot with over 43 million copies sold, with Modern Warfare (2019) comes in a close second with over 41 million copies sold. But by and large, the popularity of Call of Duty is driven by Black Ops, namely its older titles.

The prize for most successful launch, however, has to go to Modern Warfare 2 (2022) which earned $1 billion in just 10 days alongside 200 million hours played. This followed Activision Blizzard's sale to Microsoft, which also meant that Modern Warfare 2 was the first time a Call of Duty game had been on Steam since 2017 with Call of Duty: WW2 —it even made it into Steam's top 10 games by concurrent players.

The ridiculous release schedule of one Call of Duty game a year certainly seems to be working for Activision. I doubt it would've been able to pass this landmark without the tireless work of Infinity Ward, Treyarch, Sledgehammer Games, and Raven Software pumping out something new year after year. At this rate I'm pretty sure the Call of Duty franchise will outlive us all. Picture this: the dry arid landscape of an Earth pillaged and then left void of humanity, with the sole proof of our existence being the 15th Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 remaster (2193)—I hope it's good.

content.v: 黑暗日式恐怖角色扮演游戏《电电：东京恐怖》现已登陆Steam，国区首发特惠7.7折，原价76.5元，当前售价58.95元。游戏获得玩家“多半好评”评价。故事发生在东京的一夜之间，玩家将扮演照顾被遗弃老人的照护者，在资源无法帮助所有人的情况下，必须赶在黎明前决定优先拯救谁。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793108676_983815_jpg_r.jpg
游戏进程实时推进，留给玩家权衡选择的时间有限。玩家需要探索废弃公寓和昏暗街巷，寻找补给、回收途中发现的垃圾、照料老人，并收集具有不同超自然效果的护符。
探索期间，玩家还会遇到城市中的其他居民。除了使用刀具、电击器、手枪等拾取到的武器自卫，玩家也能通过交谈、撒谎、威胁或安抚处理冲突。不同决定将改变人物关系，并影响周围角色的命运。
随着黎明临近，一种与忽视、悔恨及主角过往错误有关的邪恶存在也会在城中苏醒。任何角色都有可能死亡，部分选择造成的后果无法挽回。游戏将资源管理、限时决策、探索与多路径交涉结合，玩家需要在持续增加的压力下承担每次取舍带来的结果。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261027/1793108996_483727_jpg_r.jpg
关于此游戏
Den-Den: Tokyo Horror 是一款日式恐怖RPG，每一个选择都承载着人命的重量。
日本出生率早已崩溃。老龄人口是年轻人的三倍以上，东京正在缓缓死去。 残酷的地缘政治封锁切断了食物、药品和电力供给，社会正在分崩离析，暴力犯罪激增。
你扮演一名看护者，任务是在一整夜里让被忽视的老人活下去。唯一的问题是：物资不足以供应所有人。
太阳升起时，他们之中还有多少人能活着?
欢迎来到 Den-Den: Tokyo Horror。 这个故事没有圆满结局。
主要特色
事件以实时方式展开，游戏发生在单一的一夜之中。
每过一小时，城市就会陷入更深的混乱。时间始终向前推进，你的每一个选择都会产生后果。
管理有限的物资，同时在城市中搜刮任何能找到的东西，以再多存活一小时。
利用散布在城市各处的回收机器，将垃圾变成宝物。
进入城市中分布的噩梦般的老年居住设施，照顾你所负责的被忽视的老人。
收集并装备强大的护符，获得超自然祝福。
使用厨房刀、泰瑟枪、黑市手枪等临时武器战斗或逃跑。
你的行为会带来永久后果。游戏中的每一个角色都可能因你而死。
拾荒
翻遍废弃公寓、溢出的垃圾箱、黑暗小巷，只为找到能多活一晚的东西——食物、止痛药、电池、子弹……或者一无所获。
发现
对话、倾听、撒谎、威胁或安慰。每段对话都会分支，每段关系都可能救你或毁掉你想保护的人。
战斗或逃离
绝望的市民、暴力罪犯以及更可怕的东西在街头游荡。挥舞生锈的菜刀、颤抖着开枪、用电击枪麻痹敌人，或者只是逃跑——不惜一切活到天亮。
恐惧
城市最黑暗的角落里，某种邪恶之物已经苏醒。 它以疏忽、後悔和错误决定为食。 如果你犯下太多错误……它会找上你，以及你没能守护的所有人。

content.v: The Wolf Among Us 2 is finally landing in 2027, and if you want to catch up on what many consider one of Telltale Games' best exports, you can grab The Wolf Among Us Remastered on October 29. It's the original game spruced up for new hardware and enhanced with several extras, but is it a necessary purchase? Yes and no, depending on what you expect from this package.

GameSpot senior video producer Jean-Luc Seipke went hands-on with the remaster, and in the video below, you can hear their thoughts on this Telltale classic. So how much of a difference does 13 years make? With The Wolf Among Us Remastered, Telltale has focused on subtle improvements across the board. The goal was to retain the original game's look and feel while improving lighting, adding new animations where needed, making the protagonist Bigby's werewolf transformation more intimidating, and making other nuanced tweaks under the hood.

Compared to the original, the difference isn't night and day, but the extra work adds a new visual layer to a game that already had a timeless look thanks to its strong art direction. If you're unfamiliar with the source material, The Wolf Among Us adapts Fables, an award-winning comic book series that ran for 13 years and chronicled the exploits of a secret society of exiled fairy tale characters in New York. A big hit for DC's Vertigo imprint, the series ran from 2002-2015 and made a short-lived comeback in 2022.

Beyond the graphical update, The Wolf Among Us Remastered also packs plenty of extra content. Noir Mode dresses the game in a monochrome filter, adds several deleted and extended scenes, and lets you go behind the scenes with developer commentary, concept art, interviews, and other archival materials. If that content doesn't matter to you, then the remaster might not be a necessary upgrade.

That said, Telltale is launching the game at an attractive $25 price, with a launch-week discount and even deeper savings if you already own the game. So for a few bucks more, the remastered edition is the more tempting offer, and Telltale says that it won't remove the original game from storefronts either. Progress in The Wolf Among Us Remastered will also affect how the story plays out in The Wolf Among Us 2, but as of now, we haven't heard back from Telltale on whether choices made in the original game will carry over.

Whichever version you choose, you're going to have a good time. The Wolf Among Us is an all-time classic from the Telltale library, and the remaster looks like a fun way to relive that story--or experience it for the first time--before the big bad wolf huffs and puffs down the door for his return next year.

news.title: 《生化奇兵》电影仍在拍摄中，但导演表示这是一个“棘手的难题”
news.summary: A BioShock movie at Netflix remains in development, its director has confirmed, but that doesn't necessarily m

content.v: A BioShock movie at Netflix remains in development, its director has confirmed, but that doesn't necessarily mean it'll ever be made. Francis Lawrence confirmed to The Direct that he hopes to make the BioShock movie, but "it's tricky on a couple fronts."
Lawrence said he is "definitely active" in working on the BioShock movie, but "it is a tough nut to crack that world and that story."

"You are the character when you play the game, and so creating that character from scratch into that world that, you know, quite honestly, is pretty batsh** in a most amazing way," he said. "It's tricky. So we're getting there, and we're getting close, which is great."

The BioShock movie was originally set to be a large-scale production, but when Netflix film chief Dan Lin came in, the project was scaled back . Lin recently left Netflix amid a major shakeup at the streaming giant, as did longtime chief content officer Bela Bajaria. Former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice is now the new chief content officer, and Lawrence hopes the management shakeups do not affect the BioShock movie in a big way, but nothing is ever certain in Hollywood.

"I would love nothing more than to be able to make that movie," Lawrence said of BioShock. "So still working on it. And then, you have also just the Netflix of it all because Netflix right now has had regime changes and just all of that kind of nonsense that I don't like to have to deal with or have to. So we'll see. Hopefully we'll figure it out."

Lawrence's latest project is the Hunger Games movie Sunrise on the Reaping, which releases in November. Asked if BioShock would be his next project, Lawrence said, "You never know." He said working on multiple films simultaneously creates a "horse race" kind of scenario where factors like the script, talent availability, and production realities need to align for projects to go ahead.

Curiously, BioShock producer Roy Lee said the BioShock movie is planned to coincide with the release of a new BioShock game . Lee did not name any specific games outright, but Take-Two recently reiterated that the long-in-development BioShock 4 will see the light of day … some day.

content.v: 10月27日晚，中国足协通过官方微博就姆巴佩涉华不当言论作出回应。中国足协表示，效力于西班牙皇家马德里俱乐部的运动员姆巴佩在接受海外媒体采访时公开发表涉华错误言论，中国足协高度重视，已第一时间与皇家马德里俱乐部进行严正交涉，要求涉事球员和皇家马德里俱乐部作出公开正式道歉。

中国足协在声明中强调，坚决反对任何伤害中国人民感情的言论，并指出国际知名运动员尤其应当严守底线、理性发声，珍惜自身公众影响力。中国足协同时表示，将充分利用国际多边交流平台，倡导相互尊重的国际足球交流交往准则，共同促进足球运动的健康发展与文明互鉴。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/27/small_202610272136195268.png
同日，西甲联盟已通过官方社交媒体发布声明，就姆巴佩言论向中国球迷致歉，称相关言论属于球员个人表达，绝不代表联盟立场，并表示将携手各俱乐部及球员建立文化认知与沟通规范。姆巴佩本人也发布了法语、中文和英语三语致歉声明，称自己的言论“欠妥”，对中国人民及其历史怀有“深深的敬意”，并“真心感到抱歉”。
